<!-- nativecmpkit-item:audit:IO-006 -->
## Classification
- **Finding:** IO-006
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Evidence status:** `confirmed-source` (source/test evidence is not automatically a demonstrated exploit)
- **Affected modules:** `calf-file-picker`
- **Estimated complexity:** L
- **Reviewed upstream baseline:** `af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6`; original commit preserved in this repository.

## Exact code / symbols
- [`calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt:42-60`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/androidMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.android.kt#L42-L60) — `save result IO`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt:80-88,119-123`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/iosMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf.picker/FileSaverLauncher.ios.kt#L80-L88) — `launchWithData/writeTempFile`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/desktopMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.desktop.kt:32-45,49-62`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/desktopMain/kotlin/com/mohamedrejeb/calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.desktop.kt#L32-L45) — `save coroutines`
- [`calf-file-picker/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.kt:8-18`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/af388bd3ad0325b2afdd8c0149cb7ff6f24c5da6/calf-file-picker/src/commonMain/kotlin/com.mohamedrejeb.calf/picker/FileSaverLauncher.kt#L8-L18) — `result-only contract`

## Root cause
Android uses nullable stream ?.use chains and unconditionally emits KmpFile(uri) even when opening a stream returned null. iOS ignores NSData.writeToURL Boolean and returns its URL regardless. IO exceptions in remembered coroutine scopes have no common error channel/terminal-result policy.

## Impact and preconditions
Callers may show successful exports for unwritten content, present a picker for nonexistent staging, or remain waiting when failures escape. Partial created documents are not systematically rolled back. A cancellation result cannot communicate a provider/disk failure.

## Supporting evidence
- Android lines 47,52-53 skip failed opens but line 60 still emits a file.
- iOS line 122 ignores the only success result.
- The unmerged PR #551 introduces onError overloads and staging checks; baseline has neither.

## Recommended solution
Check every open/write/copy result, close resources, remove only newly created owned partial files on failure, and add backward-compatible typed onError/result overloads. Keep cancellation distinct and rethrow coroutine cancellation rather than converting it to a generic error.

## Risks and compatibility
Do not delete an existing user-selected destination when cleanup ownership is unknown. Existing callbacks may rely on current null behavior, so document migration semantics.

## Required tests / acceptance criteria
- Resolver returns null input/output stream
- Permission revoked during read/write
- Disk-full and failing close
- iOS writeToURL returns false
- Cancellation during copy
- Exactly one terminal event for success/cancel/error

## Dependencies
- IO-002
- IO-004
- IO-005

## Historical context
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/pull/551
- https://github.com/MohamedRejeb/Calf/commit/1a20b60
Original upstream records (authors, IDs, timestamps, comments, reviews and public revisions) are archived in [`docs/migration/upstream-metadata/`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/tree/main/docs/migration/upstream-metadata). Links above are attribution; this issue is newly created for the independent project, not an impersonated original.

## Persistent technical record
[`docs/audit/findings/IO.json`](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/main/docs/audit/findings/IO.json) · [Audit](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/main/docs/audit/README.md) · [Roadmap](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/main/docs/roadmap/README.md)

### Important native identity/resource verification — reviewed 2026-10-28

[Recovery run 40749319485](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40749319485) is **SUCCESS: 9/9 actual API35 methods**, one fresh XML, zero failures/errors/skips, immutable `f616a1722700b71a5537757df4602093f1956148`. Connected Gradle exit0/78.03s; APK assembly exit0/328.10s. All804 selected inputs match this commit's own Git blobs and remain held; actual JDK17, SELinux Enforcing, clean/unforced emulator exit0.

Covered actual native distinct-inode copy/descriptor closure; non-ENOENT `ENOTDIR` refusal without damage; tree/single-document aliases read-only/no-delete; provider read revocation and new-document cleanup; public FileProvider export; actual pending-URI Activity recreation; lost bytes report error rather than empty success. Host destination-only zero/EACCES/EIO/EPERM checks separately pass **2/2** at `4fa3f1bb` (Robolectric/real Unix identity plus controlled destination metadata, not native ACL proof).

The original run40746114786 remains **FAILED/incomplete: 1/1 executed, nine absent** despite connected Gradle exit0. AGP9.4.0/Android Test Engine1.0.1 comma-delimited argument transport discarded comma-separated class/method fragments. Runtime test annotations now transport the fixed selection losslessly; strict actual-AGP selector/XML inventories remain intact. The previously accepted descriptor calibration is reused after unchanged body/helper/production review, **not rerun or counted as another fresh pass**. Local offline annotation APK acquisition failed on uncached dependencies, zero native tests; the hosted recovery supplies the actual compile/runtime evidence.

**This issue stays open.** Null stream, write revocation/error, disk-full/failing-close, iOS write/staging failure, cancellation and exactly-once terminal/native lifecycle requirements are not all certified. Original hardlink acquisition EACCES remains a separate preserved native gate; no SELinux weakening, root provisioning, process-death, minimum-device, full consumer/security/release claim. No packages/releases/deployments.

### Verified resolution — six original acceptance criteria reviewed

The owning save failure/result contract is fixed, and the required important tests have now executed and been inspected. Closing **IO-006** on its original scope immediately after source/results review; the technical issue body and upstream references remain unchanged.

1. **Null input/output opens:** two original passing Android-host provider methods are reused unchanged. A null open produces an error, never successful unwritten output; a failed input cannot open output.
2. **Revocation during read/write:** both production-copy regressions pass after a real 64 KiB chunk with deterministic provider `SecurityException`; both streams close exactly once, original causal error is preserved and only the new destination is cleaned.
3. **Disk-full/failing close:** ENOSPC write and output/input close regressions pass; completed bytes do not turn a failed close into success. Primary/suppressed errors and exactly-once ownership are checked. These are controlled provider faults, **not actual OS-grant revocation or a physically full volume**.
4. **iOS native false-write:** [40771429014](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40771429014), immutable `a0ce9389`, **1/1**, one fresh XML, Gradle **0 / 1674.62 s**, all **812 Git inputs held**, actual JDK17 / Xcode26.6 / iPhone iOS26.5. Real Foundation `writeToURL` rejects a directory; no success URL is returned, its private staging parent is removed, and a separate source/exact bytes remain intact. No mocked native Boolean.
5. **Cancellation during copy:** real coroutine cancellation propagates and stops after one copy chunk with both streams closed. Disposal during blocked host copy cleans the owner and cannot emit a stale callback.
6. **Exactly one public terminal event:** **6/6** fresh public Compose/ActivityResult/production writer methods at `8a2a46e6`, Gradle **0 / 39.01 s**, **813 Git inputs held**. Success, cancel, typed error, legacy null-error adapter, latest callbacks, duplicate results, relaunch after failure and Main-looper delivery are checked. The registry/provider boundary is controlled Android-host, not device documents UI.

Accepted writer recovery is **4/4** at `8098d87f`, **0 / 47.01 s**, 811 held inputs, plus four unchanged original passes: **eight writer methods**, not twelve. Together: **15 accepted method executions** (8 writer + 6 public terminal + 1 real iOS). Original exception-assertion/compiler/Looper failures remain preserved; successful same-input tests were not replayed. Current directly owning Android/iOS production source hashes match the accepted runs.

Original public overloads/native names are retained; typed errors are additive. Legacy error callbacks map to a single null result, cancellation remains distinct, and disposed operations suppress stale events. Desktop/source and web write/close/cancellation implementations were reviewed; this is not a full all-platform feature certificate.

**Independent gates stay open:** live UIKit export/dismissal safe points and source lifetime (#8/IO-005, IO-007), real provider grants/aliases/hard links/process death/minimum platforms, full Kotlin/JNI/Swift ABI, dependency/native-payload trust, legal notices and complete packaged consumers (#3/BUILD-006 and release-readiness). No packages, release or deployment is authorized by this closure.

Evidence: `docs/development/evidence/save-write-important-20261028/{accepted-host-review.json,terminal-host002/accepted-review.json,ios-native001/accepted-review.json,direct-closure/criteria-review.json}`. Additive final receipts/documentation follow this immediate closure; historical records are not rewritten.
